options.content:
## TraceQL cookbook

**Slow controller iterates** :
```traceql
{ service.name = "efe-meta-swarm-controller" && name = "efe.meta_swarm.iterate" && duration > 1s }
```

**Slow participant steps for a specific participant** :
```traceql
{ service.name = "efe-meta-swarm-participant" && resource.efe.participant.id = "p-foo" && name = "efe.meta_swarm.step" && duration > 500ms }
```

**Failed manifest reload** :
```traceql
{ name = "efe.meta_swarm.manifest.reload" && status = error }
```

**Failed safety check (Phase-2 generic)** :
```traceql
{ name = "efe.meta_swarm.safety_check" && status = error }
```

**Cross-process trace (controller → participant)** :
```traceql
{ span:trace:id = "<TRACE-ID>" }
```
